title: Lifting a stably-free complex from a residue quotient
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and $I\subseteq R$ an ideal such that every element of $1+I$ is invertible in $R$. Call a module $M$ over a ring $A$ finite stably free if $M\oplus A^{\oplus m}\cong A^{\oplus n}$ for some integers $m,n\ge0$. Let $K$ be an object of $D(R)$ [def-pc-derived-category] that is pseudo-coherent, that is, isomorphic in $D(R)$ to a bounded-above complex of finite free $R$-modules. Let $E^\bullet$ be a bounded-above complex of finite stably free $R/I$-modules representing $K\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R/I$ in $D(R/I)$. Then $K$ is represented in $D(R)$ by a bounded-above complex $P^\bullet$ of finite stably free $R$-modules such that $P^\bullet\otimes_RR/I$ is isomorphic to $E^\bullet$ as a complex; moreover, for every $i$ with $E^i$ free, $P^i$ may be chosen free.
